description: This file defines the restricted editing features for CKEditor5, including translation dictionaries, plugin classes, commands, UI components, and configuration for managing restricted editing regions.

classes.name: RestrictedEditingMode
classes.description: Main plugin class for restricted editing mode, managing commands and restrictions.

classes.name: RestrictedEditingModeEditing
classes.description: Plugin class handling the editing behavior and schema for restricted editing.

classes.name: RestrictedEditingModeUI
classes.description: UI component class providing dropdowns and buttons for restricted editing controls.

classes.name: RestrictedEditingExceptionAutoCommand
classes.description: Command class for automatically toggling restricted editing exceptions.

classes.name: RestrictedEditingExceptionBlockCommand
classes.description: Command class for toggling block-level restricted editing exceptions.

classes.name: RestrictedEditingExceptionCommand
classes.description: Command class for toggling inline restricted editing exceptions.

methods.name: _createMenuBarButton
methods.description: Creates a menu bar button for restricted editing commands.

methods.name: _getButtonDefinition
methods.description: Returns button configuration for a specific command.

methods.name: _getButtonDefinitions
methods.description: Returns list of button configurations for restricted editing commands.
